name: Medicine shortages
summary: US shortages of sterile injectables persist; no widespread rationing across major health systems
state: The FDA's shortage database still lists dozens of current shortages, mostly sterile injectables such as chemotherapy drugs (IntuitionLabs; Drugs.com). Searches on 7 Nov found no widespread rationing or cancelled treatment across major health systems, and no new UK Serious Shortage Protocol for a widely used medicine.
for_you: If a prescribed medicine is unavailable, speak to your pharmacist or GP; do not stop treatment without advice.
rubric_hit: Essential medicine shortages across systems = Watch; no widespread rationing (Alert)

sources.title: IntuitionLabs — Drug shortages in the United States, 2026

why: Shipping disruption, factory failures and export curbs can leave essential medicines short, as with US IV fluids after Hurricane Helene in 2024.
drivers: Manufacturing concentrated in India and China, shipping, raw materials, demand spikes, regulation.

rubric.alert: Shortages forcing widespread rationing or cancelled treatment across major health systems.
rubric.watch: A shortage of an essential medicine or supply across several countries, or a UK Serious Shortage Protocol for a widely used medicine.
rubric.normal: No widespread shortages of essential medicines in major health systems.
